defects_found.title: Skip link does not move keyboard focus to <main>
defects_found.severity: medium - accessibility regression on a newly-added fix-ticket item
defects_found.detail: The generic in-page anchor click handler (index.html ~line 667) intercepts the skip link's click, calls e.preventDefault(), and only performs a smooth scroll -- it never calls .focus() on the target. The browser's native skip-link behavior (jump + focus the tabindex=-1 target) never fires. Proven live: Tab->Enter->Tab lands back on the .brand nav link, identical to pre-fix behavior.
defects_found.recommended_fix: Call el.focus({preventScroll:true}) after scrollTo() inside the shared anchor handler, or explicitly exclude .skip-link from that handler and let the browser's native anchor navigation (or a small dedicated handler that both scrolls and focuses) run instead.
defects_found.reproduction: playwright: page.keyboard.press('Tab'); page.keyboard.press('Enter'); wait 1400ms; page.keyboard.press('Tab') -> activeElement lands on nav .brand link, not inside #main
